title: Create:Molten Metals recipe tweaks
description: tweaks the recipes of the mod "Create:Molten Metals" , to make it more rewarding to use the mod instead of just smelting metals.
body:
## **What is it**

alters recipes in the mod : "Create:Molten Metals" to (in my opinion) make it more worth it to use it over regular old furnaces or just using encased fans.

**original mod** : [Create:Molten Metals](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-molten-metals)

### **changes :**
- slag now has higher chance of producing items , especialy nuggets
- 50% more molten metal if melting raw ore (ore blocks and raw ore)
- 100% more molten metal if melting crushed ore
- when melting crushed ore you get 9 slag nuggets instead of 1 slag to make it more balenced (in my opinion)
